rv.q: Where the show falters is in the storytelling, which never establishes a natural rhythm or focus.
Proving that it’s both possible and richly rewarding to explore a classic with fresh experiences and intent, this version of The Secret Garden blooms bright.

cn.t: This fresh adaptation of the classic tale blooms with charm, featuring beautiful animal puppetry that delights as it thoughtfully explores Burnett's beloved story with rewarding intent.
